data.body: S5 ps2 pushed (df9dfea93a): added AC-1 RUNTIME single-dispatch contract test (patch runner._pai_structured spy: structured run funnels through it once, text run bypasses it) — closes the AC-1 'runner contract test that dispatch is single-sourced' sub-requirement flagged by ps1 LLM advisory. Also made the mode-census assignment resolution function-scoped (advisory #2). 8 oracle tests green, lint+typecheck clean. Advisory #3 (filename/count assertions) kept intentionally — they are AC-1's stated rationale for why a literal grep fails. Polling gates on ps2.
